body:
## Change

F1. Delete only the current incomplete shell cache when first precache fails. Same-build retry can install without update approval; failed approved updates preserve existing caches.

## Validation

V1. Identical Chromium scenario fails against fixed BASE production service worker (expected activated, received null after repaired asset) and passes changed production service worker. Parent inspected production Workbox sequencing and cleanup scope, then independently reran changed browser regression: 1 passed.
V2. Parent unit regression: 2 passed. Worker PWA-related units: 11; boundary/data-cy: 87. Typecheck, targeted lint/format/diff checks passed.
V3. Isolated git-archive build, temporary Chromium context, controlled localhost fixture; no main bootstrap recovery marker or live storage touched.

## Limits

L1. Browser storage deletion faults can still leave setup failed until storage recovers. Whole production bootstrap/full repo suites not run locally; CI separate.
title: fix(pwa): recover from incomplete first precache
